module Tests.SpecialRules where

import DA.Map as M
import DA.Either
import DA.Optional
import Daml.Script

import Chess
import Init
import Types

import Rules.Data

import Tests.Chess

testCastle = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData

  submitMustFail white do
    exerciseCmd game Move with
          move = ChessMove with
            from = E1
            to = G1
            promote = None
            check = None
  let
    moves = [
      (white, G2, G4),
      (black, G7, G6),
      (white, F1, H3),
      (black, G6, G5),
      (white, G1, F3),
      (black, F8, H6)
      ]
  game <- foldl takeMove (return $ Right game) moves

  kingCastle <- case game of
    Right g -> do
      submit white do
        exerciseCmd g Move with
          move = ChessMove with
            from = E1
            to = G1
            promote = None
            check = None
    Left _ -> abort "Should be in play"

  case kingCastle of
    Right g -> do
      Some kc <- queryContractId white g
      let
        t = do
          sm <- mapState kc.state
          king <- optionalToEither "King position not occupied" $ M.lookup (6,0) sm
          assertMsg "No King in expected position"
            (king.tp == King && king.moved)
          rook <- optionalToEither "Rook position not occupied" $ M.lookup (5,0) sm
          assertMsg "No Rook in expected position"
            (rook.tp == Rook && rook.moved)
      case t of
        Left e -> abort e
        Right _ -> assert True
    Left _ -> abort "Game should be in play"

testCheck = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData

  submitMustFail white do
    exerciseCmd game Move with
          move = ChessMove with
            from = E1
            to = G1
            promote = None
            check = Some (H4, E1)
  let
    moves = [
      (white, G2, G4),
      (black, E7, E6),
      (white, F2, F4)
      ]
  game <- foldl takeMove (return $ Right game) moves

  check <- case game of
    Right g -> do
      submit black do
        exerciseCmd g Move with
          move = ChessMove with
            from = D8
            to = H4
            promote = None
            check = Some (H4, E1)
    Left _ -> abort "Should be in play"

  case check of
    Right g -> do
      Some c <- queryContractId white g
      assertMsg "White should be checked" (c.state.everCheck == (True, False))
    Left _ -> abort "Game should be in play"

testEnPassant = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData

  submitMustFail white do
    exerciseCmd game Move with
          move = ChessMove with
            from = B2
            to = C3
            promote = None
            check = None
  let
    moves = [
      (white, B2, B4),
      (black, E7, E6),
      (white, B4, B5),
      (black, C7, C5)
      ]
  game <- foldl takeMove (return $ Right game) moves

  enPassant <- case game of
    Right g -> do
      submit white do
        exerciseCmd g Move with
          move = ChessMove with
            from = B5
            to = C6
            promote = None
            check = None
    Left _ -> abort "Should be in play"

  case enPassant of
    Right g -> do
      Some ep <- queryContractId white g
      let
        t = do
          sm <- mapState ep.state
          assertMsg "Black pawn should be gone" (isNone (M.lookup (3,5) sm))
      case t of
        Left e -> abort e
        Right _ -> assert True
    Left _ -> abort "Game should be in play"

testPromote = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData

  submitMustFail white do
    exerciseCmd game Move with
          move = ChessMove with
            from = B2
            to = C3
            promote = Some Queen
            check = None
  let
    moves = [
      (white, A2, A4),
      (black, A7, A5),
      (white, B2, B4),
      (black, A5, B4),
      (white, A4, A5),
      (black, A8, A6),
      (white, C2, C3),
      (black, A6, H6),
      (white, A5, A6),
      (black, H6, G6),
      (white, A6, A7),
      (black, G6, H6)
      ]
  game <- foldl takeMove (return $ Right game) moves

  promote <- case game of
    Right g -> do
      submit white do
        exerciseCmd g Move with
          move = ChessMove with
            from = A7
            to = A8
            promote = Some Queen
            check = None
    Left _ -> abort "Should be in play"

  case promote of
    Right g -> do
      Some p <- queryContractId white g
      let
        t = do
          sm <- mapState p.state
          queen <- optionalToEither "Queen position not occupied" $ M.lookup (0,7) sm
          assertMsg ("No Queen in expected position: " <> show queen)
            (queen.tp == Queen && queen.moved)
      case t of
        Left e -> abort e
        Right _ -> assert True
    Left _ -> abort "Game should be in play"

module Tests.SpecialRules where

import DA.Assert
import DA.Map as M
import Daml.Script

import Types
import Rules.Castle
import Rules.Data
import Rules.Main
import Rules.EnPassant
import Rules.Promotion

pieceAt : Coord -> PieceType -> Player -> Bool -> Piece
pieceAt coord tp owner moved = Piece with ..

moveTo : Coord -> Coord -> Optional PieceType -> ChessMove
moveTo from to promote = ChessMove with
  from
  to
  promote
  check = None

position : Player -> [Piece] -> [ChessMove] -> (Bool, Bool) -> GameState
position player pieces moves everCheck = GameState with ..

dataFor : GameState -> Piece -> Coord -> Optional PieceType -> MoveData
dataFor state piece destination promotion = MoveData with
  state
  stateMap = M.fromList (map (\current -> (toIntCoord current.coord, current)) state.pieces)
  move = moveTo piece.coord destination promotion
  from = toIntCoord piece.coord
  to = toIntCoord destination
  piece

testCastleMoves = script do
  let whiteKing = pieceAt E1 King White False
      whiteRook = pieceAt H1 Rook White False
      whiteState = position White [whiteKing, whiteRook] [] (False, False)
      whiteCastle = dataFor whiteState whiteKing G1 None
      blackKing = pieceAt E8 King Black False
      blackRook = pieceAt H8 Rook Black False
      blackState = position Black [blackKing, blackRook] [] (False, False)
      blackCastle = dataFor blackState blackKing G8 None
  isCastle whiteCastle === True
  isCastle blackCastle === True
  case castle whiteCastle of
    Left message -> abort message
    Right board -> do
      M.lookup (toIntCoord G1) board === Some (whiteKing with coord = G1; moved = True)
      M.lookup (toIntCoord F1) board === Some (whiteRook with coord = F1; moved = True)
      M.lookup (toIntCoord E1) board === None
      M.lookup (toIntCoord H1) board === None
  case castle blackCastle of
    Left message -> abort message
    Right board -> do
      M.lookup (toIntCoord G8) board === Some (blackKing with coord = G8; moved = True)
      M.lookup (toIntCoord F8) board === Some (blackRook with coord = F8; moved = True)
      M.lookup (toIntCoord H8) board === None

testCastleQueenSide = script do
  let king = pieceAt E1 King White False
      rook = pieceAt A1 Rook White False
      board = position White [king, rook] [] (False, False)
  case castle (dataFor board king C1 None) of
    Left message -> abort message
    Right result -> do
      M.lookup (toIntCoord C1) result === Some (king with coord = C1; moved = True)
      M.lookup (toIntCoord E1) result === None
      M.lookup (toIntCoord A1) result === None

testCastleRefusals = script do
  let king = pieceAt E1 King White False
      rook = pieceAt H1 Rook White False
      base = position White [king, rook] [] (False, False)
      attempt state moving = castle (dataFor state moving G1 None)
  attempt (base with pieces = [(king with moved = True), rook]) (king with moved = True)
    === Left "Move an unmoved, unchecked King to castle"
  attempt (base with everCheck = (True, False)) king
    === Left "Move an unmoved, unchecked King to castle"
  attempt (base with pieces = [king]) king === Left "Rook position not occupied"
  attempt (base with pieces = [king, (rook with moved = True)]) king
    === Left "Castling needs an unmoved rook"
  attempt (base with pieces = [king, pieceAt H1 Bishop White False]) king
    === Left "Castling needs an unmoved rook"
  attempt (base with pieces = [king, rook, pieceAt F1 Knight White False]) king
    === Left "Path blocked"
  attempt (base with pieces = [king, rook, pieceAt G1 Pawn Black False]) king
    === Left "Path blocked"
  castle (dataFor base king G8 None) === Left "Invalid target for castle"
  let blackKing = pieceAt E8 King Black False
      blackRook = pieceAt H8 Rook Black False
      blackBase = position Black [blackKing, blackRook] [] (False, True)
  castle (dataFor blackBase blackKing G8 None)
    === Left "Move an unmoved, unchecked King to castle"
  isCastle (dataFor base rook F1 None) === False
  isCastle (dataFor base king F1 None) === False

testEnPassantTargets = script do
  let whitePawn = pieceAt E5 Pawn White True
      blackPawn = pieceAt D5 Pawn Black True
      blackAdvance = moveTo D7 D5 None
      whiteState = position White [whitePawn, blackPawn] [blackAdvance] (False, False)
      blackCapturer = pieceAt E4 Pawn Black True
      whiteVictim = pieceAt D4 Pawn White True
      whiteAdvance = moveTo D2 D4 None
      blackState = position Black [blackCapturer, whiteVictim] [whiteAdvance] (False, False)
  target (dataFor whiteState whitePawn D6 None) === Right (toIntCoord D5)
  target (dataFor blackState blackCapturer D3 None) === Right (toIntCoord D4)
  target (dataFor whiteState whitePawn F6 None) === Right (toIntCoord F6)
  target (dataFor (whiteState with moves = []) whitePawn D6 None) === Right (toIntCoord D6)
  target (dataFor (whiteState with moves = [moveTo D6 D5 None]) whitePawn D6 None)
    === Right (toIntCoord D6)
  target (dataFor (whiteState with pieces = [whitePawn, (blackPawn with tp = Knight)]) whitePawn D6 None)
    === Right (toIntCoord D6)
  target (dataFor whiteState (whitePawn with tp = Bishop) D6 None)
    === Right (toIntCoord D6)
  target (dataFor (whiteState with moves = [moveTo A7 A5 None, blackAdvance]) whitePawn D6 None)
    === Left "Unexpected error: Piece not found."

testPromotion = script do

      blackBoard = position Black [blackPawn] [] (False, False)
      promote state pawn destination selection =

  promote whiteBoard whitePawn H8 (Some Queen) === Right Queen
  promote whiteBoard whitePawn H8 (Some Knight) === Right Knight
  promote blackBoard blackPawn A1 (Some Rook) === Right Rook
  promote blackBoard blackPawn A1 (Some Bishop) === Right Bishop
  promote whiteBoard whitePawn H8 None === Right Pawn
  promote blackBoard blackPawn A1 None === Right Pawn
  promote whiteBoard whitePawn H6 (Some Queen) === Left "Promotion not allowed"
  promote blackBoard blackPawn A3 (Some Queen) === Left "Promotion not allowed"
  promote blackBoard (blackPawn with tp = Knight) A1 (Some Queen)

    === Left "Promotion not allowed"
  promote (blackBoard with player = White) blackPawn A1 (Some Queen)
